$comment: What to import, and the budget each species is allowed. Driven by
tools/vegetation-import/import_vegetation.py — see its README.md.
Per species: `source` is the Poly Haven asset id (CC0 1.0), `meshes` selects which of
the source's meshes to take (a Poly Haven plant asset usually ships several variants in
one file; taking all of them stacks them on top of each other), and `groups` splits the
result into submeshes. One group becomes one OBJ `usemtl` block, one albedo texture and
one FoliageRenderer draw part, so the split IS the per-species texture assignment.
Modes:
direct   take the geometry as scanned. For ground cover, whose blades and fronds are
already at a sensible triangle count and whose shape is the point.
solid    grid vertex-cluster decimation to `target_tris`. Trunks and bark only — a
closed surface survives this; thin foliage does not.
foliage  rebuild as cross-cards, `cards` of them, textured from an atlas of `tiles`
tiles baked out of the scan itself. The only workable treatment for a canopy
of individually modelled needles or leaves.
Budgets are triangles, chosen against issue #1398's bar that a hero conifer belongs two
orders of magnitude above the 48-face stand-in it replaced.
A BRANCH BUDGET IS NOT A TRUNK BUDGET. A trunk is one thick surface and decimates 17x
happily; the pine's `bark` submesh is its BRANCH structure - thin tubes - which clustering
merges across each other. At 3,500 the budget search could only reach the target by
coarsening the UV bucket count from 6 to 3, and that weakened the seam protection enough to
leave 98 zero-UV-area triangles (the engine logs them: MeshOptimization, 98 of 3279). 14,000
is where the search meets the budget at the full 6 buckets. Set a branchy submesh's budget
above the point where decimate_to_budget has to trade UV buckets away - it reports the count
it settled on, so the number is visible rather than inferred.
THE SIZE TRAP: `resolution` selects TEXTURES ONLY. The source mesh buffer is identical
at 1k, 2k and 4k — pine_tree_01.bin is 949 MB whichever tier you name.
